_meta.purpose: standalone_fact singletons to reclassify (demote) out of the conflict corpus

verified.note: ~2.5% residual are borderline-contestable technical theses (e.g. 'hallucinations statistically inevitable'); acceptable because the reclassification is REVERSIBLE (status=demoted, instance kept) — a mis-demoted claim is flipped back, not lost.
